title: GeoPoliced Proof Catalog and Retention Sentinel
creator: Maya Patel
description: Introduce a coordinated proof catalog and enforcement agent (Retention Sentinel) that automatically maps SOC 2 / ISO 27001 controls to machine-collectible artifacts, tags artifacts with jurisdiction and retention metadata, and enforces time-to-live and export requirements. The goal is to reduce manual audit assembly work for compliance teams by providing tamper-evident, queryable proof bundles scoped to region and control family. This initiative focuses on: control mapping, lightweight collectors for runtime telemetry and configuration snapshots, evidence fingerprinting (SHA-256), geo-tagged custody metadata, retention enforcement with safe export bundles, and an operator playbook for audits.
acceptance_criteria: Control-to-artifact mapping table exists for top 25 SOC 2/ISO controls and is stored in Confluence
Collectors produce JSON-LD artifacts with required schema and jurisdiction tags
Retention Sentinel enforces TTLs and moves expired artifacts to secure archive with checksum and write-once flag
Audit export endpoint can generate a signed proof bundle (zip) containing artifacts, signing metadata, and unforgeable manifest
End-to-end demo of a region-specific evidence export for a sample control (Logging: SOC2 CC6) validated by Security team
tasks: Draft control mapping matrix and validation rules (PM + Security)
Spec collector API schema (JSON-LD) and minimal fields: artifact_id, control_id, timestamp, issuer, jurisdiction, hash, storage_pointer
Design retention policy DSL (human readable) and default policies by jurisdiction
Implement Retention Sentinel — policy enforcer that marks, archives, and snapshots artifacts
Build audit bundle generator with manifest signing (KMS integration)
Create Console UI surface for proof catalog browsing and ad-hoc exports
E2E test: create artifacts, wait TTL, verify archival and signed export
risk_and_mitigation: Risk: Misclassification of jurisdiction leading to incorrect retention. Mitigation: conservative defaults + operator override audit trail
Risk: Large volume of artifacts causing storage blowup. Mitigation: sampling policy, deduplication via artifact hash, and cold archive integration
Risk: Export bundles could expose PII if not redacted. Mitigation: redaction pipeline + pre-export policy checks + reviewer approval for high-risk exports
